title: Mat Salleh Rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Mat Salleh Rebellion", at revision 1377040626, opens: "The Mat Salleh Rebellion was a series of major armed disturbances against the British North Borneo Chartered Company administration in North Borneo, now the Malaysian state of Sabah. It was instigated by Datu Muhammad Salleh, a local chief from the Lingkabo district and Sugut River. He led the rebellion between 1894 until his death in Tambunan in 1900. The rebellion then continued on for another five years until 1905." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1908014, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1894–1905 rebellion against British colonial rule in North Borneo". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
